authority: authoring-template-only; the same-path registry is canonical and projections are read-only

lane_contract.ref_rule: Every selectable ref carries path, sha256 digest, validity, and invalidation; missing refs force blocked state.
lane_contract.consumed_set_rule: Each lane inherits defaults.consumed_set with files, symbols, generated, fixtures, effects, forbidden, tools, contract, and context categories.
lane_contract.dependency_rule: authored_dependencies are N00-N17 IDs sourced from source_context.dependency_graph; N09 epochs do not add a DAG edge; N10/N11 remain independent.
lane_contract.prelaunch_rule: All lanes are blocked and leases unissued until compile, namespace, standards, and four-persona exposure gates pass; an exact run-scoped lease normalizes absolute/symlink paths, resolves linked-worktree gitdir targets, protects exact .git metadata files and Git refs only, records positive/negative overlap examples, and fails closed on overlap.

claim_authority.claim_ceiling: All CL-* rows remain withheld until same-surface proof and root reconciliation exist.

projection_contract.binding: Use exact parent commit/tree and recompute payload/source projection digests only after the candidate settles; never embed circular authority self-digests.

selection: Board is routing context only. Old custom tooling, legacy lane snapshots, stale branches, and duplicate ExecPlans are tombstone history and never selectable.
